texts.zh:
我们成功地恢复了[gateway_system.GetName]星系中远古星门的供能！尽管年代久远，这座装置还是形成了一条完全可以供通行的稳定亚空间通路。

我们还检测到了异常的、类似于进出星门时的能量读数，但没有任何船只过境的迹象。
texts.en:
We have successfully restored power to the ancient Gateway in the [gateway_system.GetName] system! Despite its age, the device has formed a stable subspace conduit that is fully traversable.

We're also detecting unusual energy readings, similar to those that occur when entering or exiting a gate, but without any evidence of a ship in transit.

texts.zh:
一艘巨大的舰船从星门中出现，它的体积之巨大我们前所未见。军队已处于高度戒备状态。

那艘未知舰船对我们的呼叫没有应答，但鉴于它似乎完全处于瘫痪状态，我们暂时不会与它交战。我们仍在进行调查并试图开启通讯。
texts.en:
A hulking ship has emerged from the gate, its sheer scale unlike anything we have seen before. Military forces have been put on high alert.

The unknown vessel is not responding to our hails, but given the fact that it appears completely disabled, we will not engage it for now. Investigation and attempts to open comms continue.

texts.zh:
我们对这艘巨大舰船的调查并没有得到很多信息。然而，我们已经能够破译星门第一次打开时收到的一些数据。看来，这艘舰船已经被困在星门里一段时间了（可能久得难以想象）。

为了了解更多，我们需要登上它。由于这是一艘军舰，建议派遣特种部队。
texts.en:
Our investigation into the hulking ship hasn't yielded many answers. However, we have been able to decipher some of the data we received when the gate first opened. It appears that the ship has been stuck inside the gate for an unknown (and possibly incredible) length of time.

To find out more, we will need to board the ship. As it is a military vessel, sending a special ops unit is advised.

texts.zh:
在登上舰船后不久，我们就遭遇了一队异形的外星人。由于我们的突然出现，许多外星人受到了惊吓，纷纷拔出武器。谢天谢地，交火得以避免！

在要求双方冷静下来之后，外星人指挥官解释道这艘船需要进行紧急维修。一旦所有系统正常运转，他和他的船员打算返回自己的母星，斯卡拉维德。

这位指挥官全身着军队盛装礼服，其形象十分令人深刻。这艘舰船的船员在提及他时都满怀敬意，其个人魅力甚至影响到了我方人员。他已经营造了双边建立正式外交关系的可能性。
texts.en:
Soon after boarding the vessel, we encountered a group of uniformed aliens. Startled by our sudden appearance, many were quick to draw weapons. Thankfully, a firefight was avoided.

Calling for calm, the alien commander explained that the ship is in need of emergency repairs. Once all systems are operational, he and his crew intend to return to their home planet, Skravird.

Dressed in full military regalia, he certainly cuts an impressive figure. The ship's crew speak of him with reverence, and the force of his personality is palpable even to our people. He has already raised the possibility of establishing formal diplomatic relations.

texts.zh:
在舰船的内部，我们发现了一支外星人团队，他们正在尝试修复舰船的功能。我们的突然出现让他们感觉受到了威胁，许多外星人很快拔出了武器。尽管避免了冲突，这位外星人指挥官显然还是把我们当做了敌人。

他身着全套军服，器宇不凡。即便在我们看来，他的人格魅力也是显而易见的。然而，目前似乎很难进行进一步的沟通。
texts.en:
Inside the vessel, we discovered a group of aliens working to restore the ship's functionality. Viewing our sudden appearance as a threat, many were quick to draw weapons. Although violence was avoided, the alien commander clearly views us as adversaries.

Dressed in full military regalia, he cuts an impressive figure. The force of his personality is palpable even to us. However, at this point further dialogue seems unlikely.

label.zh: 帮助指挥官修复他的舰船。
label.en: Help this commander repair his ship.

label.zh: 无视他。转而扣押这艘舰船。
label.en: Ignore him. Seize the ship instead.

texts.zh:
我们的工程团队已经对外星人船员提供了援助。这艘船的番号大致可以翻译作“利爪一号”，外星指挥官自称斯克兰德·夏普比克，是一位享有盛名的海军上将。

通过对比利爪一号和我们自己的数据，我们确认斯克兰德和他的船员被困在星门里长达几千年。对他们来说，这是一次短暂的旅行，但对星系的其他地方来说，几千年已经过去了。

得益于我们对斯卡拉维德的发掘，至少我们已经能向夏普比克司令指出他故乡星球的所在了，但他曾经爱过的所有人和事都早已离去。
texts.en:
Our engineering team has ably assisted the alien crew. The vessel's designation translates roughly to 'First Talon', and their commander has identified himself as Skrand Sharpbeak, an admiral of renown.

By comparing data from the First Talon's databanks and our own, we have confirmed that Skrand and his crew were trapped within the gate for several millennia. For them, it was a short trip - but for the rest of the galaxy, thousands of years passed by.

Thanks to our excavation on Skravird, at least we can point Admiral Sharpbeak towards his home planet, but everything and everyone he has have ever loved is long since gone.

texts.zh:
我们的工程团队已经对外星人船员提供了援助。这艘船的番号大致可以翻译作“利爪一号”，外星指挥官自称斯克兰德·夏普比克，是一位享有盛名的海军上将。

通过对比利爪一号和我们自己的数据，我们确认斯克兰德和他的船员被困在星门里长达几千年。对他们来说，这是一次短暂的旅行，但对星系的其他地方来说，几千年已经过去了。

他们无家可归，他们曾经爱过的所有人和事都早已离去。
texts.en:
Our engineering team has ably assisted the alien crew. The vessel's designation translates roughly to 'First Talon', and their commander has identified himself as Skrand Sharpbeak, an admiral of renown.

By comparing data from the First Talon's databanks and our own, we have confirmed that Skrand and his crew were trapped within the gate for several millennia. For them, it was a short trip - but for the rest of the galaxy, thousands of years passed by.

They have no home to return to. Everything and everyone they have have ever loved is long since gone.

texts.zh:
利爪一号的舰队司令斯克兰德·夏普比克向我们打了个招呼。他显得精疲力竭。

斯卡拉维德陷落了。我的家园不复存在了。数十亿的生命……逝去了。

利爪一号就这么变成了最后一艘利爪号，而我也变成了一个无依无靠的士兵。感谢你们的帮助，我代表我的船员宣誓效忠。
texts.en:
Admiral Skrand Sharpbeak of the First Talon hails us. He appears exhausted.

Skravird has fallen. My home is no more. Billions of lives... gone.

The First Talon has become The Last Talon, and I am a soldier without a cause. For your help, and on behalf of my crew, I pledge our allegiance.

label.zh: 谢谢。但我们也有值得尊敬的指挥官。
label.en: Our thanks. But we have worthy commanders of our own.

label.zh: 那你有什么能耐阻止我们据为己有吗？
label.en: What is to prevent us from simply taking it ourselves?

texts.zh: 我们的士兵轻易地战胜了外星舰船的船员。我们摧毁了他们的防御，清理掉了舰桥上的敌军士兵。这艘船是我们的了！
texts.en: Our troops easily overpowered the vessel's crew. We destroyed their defenses and cleared the bridge of enemy soldiers. The ship is ours!

texts.zh: 我方登录外星舰船的部队遭到了残虐！敌人令人难以置信地凶悍。结束战斗后，我们重启了舰船的战术系统。系统显示，超光速引擎仍然无法启动，但舰船本身正在主动争夺我们的控制权。
texts.en: Our troops aboard the alien vessel were decimated! The ferocity of the defenders was incredible. After the battle, power was returned to the ship's tactical systems. According to our scans, the hyperdrive is still inoperable, but the vessel itself is actively contesting our space.

texts.zh:
随着一种新型瘟疫在舰船上散播开来，利爪一号上的船员们开始陷入恐慌。根据初步的分析判断，对于我们的族群而言，这是一种相对无害的病毒。然而，对于船上的鸟类船员来说情况就不一样了，病毒首先附着在羽毛上，导致羽毛根部感染腐烂，不出几天，感染就会蔓延到血液中。

如果任由这样发展下去，最终会达到不可挽回的地步。
texts.en:
Panic grips the crew of the First Talon as a novel disease is sweeping across the ship. According to initial analysis, it's a strain of a relatively harmless virus, common to our people. However, to the avian crew of the Talon, its effects are both serious and disturbing. First manifesting in the plumage, the virus causes feathers to rot at the root. Within days, the rot spreads to the blood.

Over time, it is likely to prove fatal.

texts.zh: 尽管我们用尽全力，但斯克兰德还是倒在了坏羽病的侵袭之下。他的同伴们正准备为此举行一场传统的葬礼仪式。
texts.en: Despite our best efforts, Skrand has succumbed to Feather Rot. His crew are preparing a traditional funeral service.

texts.zh: 尽管我们在利爪一号上采取了严格的隔离措施，但根据斯克兰德刚刚的报告，估计船上约有60%的船员已被感染。
texts.en: Despite our best efforts to quarantine the First Talon, Admiral Skrand has contracted a severe case of Feather Rot. We estimate that 60% of his crew is already sick.

texts.zh: 到目前为止，坏羽病的新症状几乎在一夜之间就涌现出来了，这超出了利爪一号自身医务室的处理极限，船上的走廊里挤满了病患还有奄奄一息的船员。
texts.en: Hitherto unseen symptoms of the Feather Rot epidemic have appeared almost overnight. The First Talon's sickbay is overflowing, and the ship's corridors are full of the sick and dying.

texts.zh: 舰船已经汇报了坏羽病导致的第一例死亡病例。那些鸟类船员目前仍然无法抵御病毒的感染，除非我们能找到治疗方法，不然的话据推算最终死亡率可达95%。
texts.en: The first fatalities of the Feather Rot epidemic have been reported. The avians remain unable to fight off the infection on their own, and unless we find a way a cure, we estimate a mortality rate of 95%.

texts.zh: 在数月的努力后，我们成功治愈了利爪一号上染病的船员们，舰船运转逐步重回正轨。毫无疑问斯克兰德将非常感谢我们在这件事上的帮助。
texts.en: After months of work, we were able to administer a successful treatment to the crew of the First Talon. Efforts are underway to up production. Admiral Skrand will no doubt be very grateful for our help in this matter.

texts.zh: 我们的人员一直在努力促进与斯克兰德和他的船员的关系。这种跨文化交流的努力已经取得初步成效：刚刚斯克兰德同意提供他们高效舰载机的设计。这可能会大大提升我们对太空作战的理解。
texts.en: Our personnel have worked hard to foster relations with Skrand and his crewmates. This effort in cross-cultural exchange is already bearing fruit: Skrand has just agreed to hand over the designs for their highly efficient strike craft. This could lead to a great leap in our understanding of space combat.

label.zh: 我们对该礼物表达感激
label.en: We are thankful for this gift.

texts.zh: 历时数月的研究、编写和实验终于提供了一些启发。外星飞船的计算机库包含了舰载机编队的适应性战术。现在这项技术由我们来运用。
texts.en: Months of studying, cataloging, and experimenting finally provided some insight. The alien vessel's computer banks contain adaptive tactics in strike craft formation. Now, this technology is ours to implement.

texts.zh: 显然，斯克兰德陷入了与我们自己的一位指挥官[leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName]的肢体冲突。问题与舰队司令的个人荣誉感有关。简而言之，斯克兰德觉得自己受到了侮辱，他表示，除非我们解除[leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName]的职务，否则他将立即离开我们。
texts.en: Apparently Skrand got into a physical altercation with [leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName], one of our own commanders. The issue has to do with the Admiral's deep sense of personal honor. In short, Skrand feels insulted, and has stated he will leave our service immediately unless we relieve [leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName] of their duties.

texts.zh:
虽然我们的基层军官和指挥官正在与斯克兰德密切合作，但他们也不是完全言听计从。双方所习惯的指挥结构不同，带来了一些不必要的紧张局面。因此我们亟需一场联合军事演练。

该演练可能会降低我们指挥舰队的能力，但不能准备好军队的话可能会导致极其严重的后果。
texts.en:
Our officers and commanders are working closely with Skrand, but they are not always in accord with him. Their preferred command structures differ, causing unnecessary tension. This has precipitated a need for joint military training.

The work may limit our ability to command our fleets, but failing to properly prepare the troops could have dire consequences.

label.zh: 这种军事演习有什么意义么。

texts.zh: 双方都取得了显著进展，我们认为联合演训项目取得了巨大成功。我们从斯克兰德那里学到了很多关于近距离太空作战的知识，同时他和他的军官们也熟悉了我们的后勤系统。一种新的乐观主义和同志情谊已经在军队中扎根下来。
texts.en: With exceptional progress on both sides, we consider the joint training program a great success. We learned much from Skrand about close-quarters space combat, while bringing him and his officers up to speed on our logistics practices. A new sense of optimism and camaraderie has taken root.

texts.zh:
主要问题在于我们使用舰载机的战术截然不同。斯克兰德部署了多个大型攻击机小组来打破敌人的指挥链。他们在母舰的明确目标下联合行动。

我们的方法则更灵活，让他们承担一些态势感知型的任务，并去执行高危险高回报的行动，但我们缺乏斯克兰德和他的军官所拥有的大局观。目前，我们还在努力寻找可以一起建立的共同基础。
texts.en:
The main problem lies in how differently we employ strike-craft tactics. Skrand deploys multiple large strike-craft teams to break the enemy's chain of command. They operate united by clear objectives from their mother ship.

Our approach is more flexible with roles dictated by situational awareness and the use of potentially high-risk, high-reward actions, but we lack the cohesion seen in Skrand and his officers. For now, we still strive to find a common ground to build on.

texts.zh:
模拟战斗表明，斯克兰德的集中火力战术在最初阶段非常奏效，但很快会被反制战术所克制。即便如此，他战果也还是比起我们的的表现好得多。

同时实施这两种战术会导致混乱。幸运的是，从这些失败中产生了可能想法，这将缓解潜在的问题。
texts.en:
Simulation battles have shown Skrand's concentrated tactics are very effective at first, but quickly fail against counter strategies. Even so, the results were superior to those we could expect ourselves.

Implementing parts of both tactics in parallel resulted in chaos. Fortunately, from these failures emerged promising ideas that should alleviate the underlying problems.

texts.zh: 显然，斯克兰德陷入了与我们自己的一位指挥官[leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName]的肢体冲突。问题与舰队司令的个人荣誉感有关。简而言之，斯克兰德觉得自己受到了侮辱，他表示，除非我们解除[leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName]的职务，否则他将立即离开我们。
texts.en: Apparently Skrand got into a physical altercation with [leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName], one of our own commanders. The issue has to do with the Admiral's deep sense of personal honor. In short, Skrand feels insulted, and has stated he will leave our service immediately unless we relieve [leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName] of their duties.

texts.zh: 显然，斯克兰德陷入了与我们自己的一位指挥官[leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName]的肢体冲突。问题与舰队司令的个人荣誉感有关。简而言之，斯克兰德觉得自己受到了侮辱，他表示，除非我们解除[leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName]的职务，否则他将立即离开我们。
texts.en: Apparently Skrand got into a physical altercation with [leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName], one of our own commanders. The issue has to do with the Admiral's deep sense of personal honor. In short, Skrand feels insulted, and has stated he will leave our service immediately unless we relieve [leader_to_fire_skrand.GetName] of their duties.

texts.zh:
我们对利爪终号的联合研究得到了对这艘钢铁巨兽内部运作方式的独到见解。我们相信我们的研究团队跟利爪号的船员们通力合作将有可能进一步改进舰船的外部结构，让它面对攻击和船体破坏具有更强的抵抗力。

我们已经获得了斯克兰德的允许，但项目还需要更多资金。
texts.en:
Our joint research on the Last Talon has given us unique insights into the inner workings of this behemoth. We believe that our engineering team, in cooperation with those aboard the Talon, have an opportunity to further improve the outer layers of the ship, making it even more resistant to attacks and potential hull breaches.

We have already received permission from Skrand, but the project will require further funds.

label.en: We don't have resources for this.

texts.zh: 虽然我们没能完成预定目标，但还是成功地改进了利爪号的装甲系统。我们的工程师还发现了可以用于改进我们自己舰船的灵感。
texts.en: Although we didn't achieve the desired results, we managed to improve the Talon's armor systems. Our engineers also found valuable insights that can be applied to improve our own ships.

texts.zh: 我们对改进利爪号的结构强度而不牺牲速度或机动性进行了诸多努力，但进展相当缓慢。斯克兰德的工程师虽然帮了我们很多忙，但是他们不愿意我们在没有密切监督的情况下实施我们的想法。尽管如此，工作仍在继续推进。
texts.en: We have made several different attempts to increase the Talon's structural integrity without compromising speed or maneuverability, but progress has been slow. The assistance of Skrands' engineers has been a great boon to us, but they are reluctant to implement our ideas without close supervision. However, work continues to move forward.

texts.zh:
利爪号的部分材料和我们的同类产品不同。这些合金的韧性更差，导致船体在安装额外的装甲板时意外断裂。驻船工程师对我们的监督是正确的，幸好意外发生时他们就在附近。

我们需要使用一些原来用于升级的材料来维修船体，这将会导致整个升级工作的延迟。
texts.en:
Some of the Talon's materials differ from our equivalents. Its alloy is much less flexible, which caused the hull to break unexpectedly during the installation of additional armor plates. The ship's engineers were right to oversee our work, and we were lucky they were nearby.

We had to use some of the materials allocated for improvements to repair the ship, which has in turn delayed the whole operation.

texts.zh:
闪烁的屏幕上浮现出斯克兰德的指挥界面。这位舰队司令的羽翼蓬立，双眼发出锐利的目光。

这些……混账！他们只知道杀戮、破坏！

他愤怒地咬紧了喙，继续说。

我请求……不，我下令发起战争！我们不能让他们毁掉一切，让我们再次一无所有！我、我相信我们一起可以防止我人民所遭遇的悲剧再度重演。我已经准备好与你们分享我们所知道的一切。
texts.en:
The screen flickers as Skrand's command deck appears. The admiral's feathers are ruffled, his sharp eyes flashing.

These... outsiders! They came here only to kill, to destroy!

Clacking his beak furiously, he continues.

I request-- No, I DEMAND that we declare war! We can't let them destroy everything, not again! I... Together I believe we can prevent a repeat of what befell my people. I am ready to teach you everything we know.

label.zh: 你之前曾和这些威胁交过手吗？
label.en: Have you come into contact with this threat before?

label.zh: 我们不能在这里浪费资源。
label.en: We can't spend resources on this.

texts.zh: 得益于斯克兰德对“威胁”作战的专长，及其提供的海量数据，我们现在面对这些涌现出来的天灾更加有备无患了。下一步就是将这些知识落到实处。
texts.en: Thanks to Skrand's expertise in warfare against the Menace, and the vast database he has provided, we are now much better equipped to deal with the emerging crisis. All that remains is to put this knowledge to good use.

texts.zh:
我们获得的数据库中可查询到一些斯克兰德的帝国时代这些威胁的作战方式实例。看来，他们使用的策略确实类似于我们今天所面对的那些。他们的舰队不使用正常的物流方案，通常是自给自足的。

更重要的是，干扰技术对他们不怎么起作用。破坏操作同样没有用。
texts.en:
The databanks we've accessed provide us with some examples of how the Menace fought during the time of Skrand's empire. It appears that they used tactics similar to those we face today. They rarely use standard logistical schemes, and their fleets are usually self-sufficient.

More importantly, jamming technology is not as effective against such forces. Sabotage operations are likewise useless.

texts.zh: 将我们与斯克兰德的数据进行对比得出了一些有趣的结论。似乎这些敌人相当地古板：它的大型舰队一次只聚焦在一个目标，而忽视其他所有的东西。我们应该可以识别他们的目标，并进行相应的防御。
texts.en: Comparing our own data to Skrand's, we have come to some interesting conclusions. It turns out that the enemy is quite inflexible: its largest fleets focus on one target at a time, to the exclusion of all else. It should be possible to identify such targets and defend accordingly.

texts.zh: 利爪号上的一群工程师帮传达了一条来自斯克兰德的指令。他们请求我们帮助维护利爪号的框架，并让我们的船坞做好修船的准备。如上所述，这些计划代价高昂。而且还有一个问题：考虑到这项工作的微妙性质，斯克兰德将不得不亲自监督该项目。
texts.en: A group of engineers from the Talon has delivered an order from Skrand himself. They requested help to maintain the Talon's frame and prepare our shipyards for potential repairs. As outlined, these plans would be a costly process. And there is one catch: given the delicate nature of the work, Skrand will have to oversee the project himself.

texts.zh: 在我们的帮助下，利爪号的工程师成功地对我们的船坞进行了复古改装，以对利爪号的内部结构进行研究。他们利用我们的实验性的设计改进了他们的超光速引擎，使得即使在发生船体严重损坏的情况下，舰船仍然能够跃迁。虽然使用这种引擎会导致几乎瞬间到达目的地，但是它也会杀死船上的所有人，并且可能使舰船在数年内无法使用。另一方面，如果舰船在战斗中损毁，我们依然能可以尝试激活这个系统并修复残骸。
texts.en: With our help, the Talon's engineers have retrofitted our shipyards to study the Talon's inner workings. Making use of our experimental designs they enhanced their FTL drives, which allow the ship to jump even after a critical hull breach. Although usage of this drive will result in almost instantaneous travel, it will also kill everyone on board and probably render the ship inoperable for years. On the other hand, if the ship is lost in battle, we can try to activate the system and recover the wreckage.

texts.zh: 在利爪号工程师团队的密切支持和监督下，我们成功地重建了船体。利爪号再度启航！
texts.en: With the close support and supervision of the Talon's engineering team, we were able to rebuild the hull. The Talon takes flight again!

texts.zh: 多亏了额外的安全系统以及紧急协议，斯克兰德的旗舰在受到严重损坏后仍成功进行了紧急超光速跃迁。尽管出现在我们首都星球上方的残骸几乎无法被识别为一艘舰船，但船体依然可以作为重建的基础。这些残骸现在正在船坞等待修理。或者，我们可以对船体进行材料回收。考虑到它的状态，即便是我们认定这艘舰船的残骸无法修复的，斯克兰德也会理解这个决定。
texts.en: Thanks to additional failsafe systems and emergency protocols, Skrands' flagship managed to enter emergency FTL even after taking critical damage. Although what appeared in the skies above our capital world is barely recognizable as a ship, the hull can serve as a basis for rebuilding. The remains are now waiting at the docks for repairs. Alternatively, we could the hull for materials. Given its state, even Skrand would understand the decision if we deemed the wreck impossible to repair.

label.en: Scrap it, we need the alloys.

texts.zh: 近期在基因工程方面的进展有助于重新恢复舰队司令斯克兰德的种族。也许暂时还不具有相应的基因多样性来确保他们继续繁衍，但用兼容的基因填补空白应该可以完成这项工作。我们现在只需要足够的资金就可以开始行动。
texts.en: Recent developments in genetic engineering could enable us to repopulate Admiral Skrand's species. We may lack the genetic diversity to make them fully capable of reproduction, but filling in the gaps with compatible genes should get the job done. All that is required to get started is adequate funding.

label.zh: 斯克兰德作出了很多贡献。他完全配得上这个。
label.en: Skrand has served us well. He deserves this much.
We don't have time for this.

texts.zh: 我们复制斯克兰德DNA的工作某种意义上还是成功了。尽管他们的外观完全一致，但是克隆体的基因组成与斯克兰德的完全不同，它们构成了一个新物种。他们开始称自己为塔隆人。
texts.en: Our efforts to replicate Skrand's DNA have been more or less successful. Although their appearance is identical, the genetic makeup of the clones is different enough from Skrand's that they constitute a new species. We are told they have taken to calling themselves the Talons.

texts.zh: 斯克兰德的鸟类DNA远比预想的要顽固，以至于有必要将其他鸟类的基因拼接起来。这个方法并不理想，但应该能让我们完成这项工作。
texts.en: Skrand's avian DNA is far more rigid than expected, so much so that it has been necessary to splice genes from other avian species. The approach is not ideal, but it should allow us to finish the job.

texts.zh:
斯克兰德的制服一尘不染，他的羽翼油光发亮。

我已经看到了你们小小基因实验的成果。虽然这些克隆体还差强人意，但我相当感谢你们的努力。
texts.en:
Skrand's uniform is in perfect condition, his feathers well groomed.

I saw the result of your little genetic experiment. These clones are far from perfect, but I am grateful for your attempt.

label.en: We are sorry to hear that.

texts.zh: 我们收到了一份来自许多利爪号船员的请求。他们要求我们调配资源研究他们民族的过往。在利爪号徘徊于亚空间的时候发生了许多许多事情。他们希望能为子孙后代记录下一些东西。
texts.en: We received a request from several members of the Talon's crew. They have asked us to use our resources to research their people's past. Much occurred while the Talon lay in limbo. They have asked that it be recorded for posterity.

texts.zh:
我们收到了关于斯克兰德和他的人民历史的第一份报告:

在他们的时代，星系广阔而未知，星系外边缘被视为太过危险，无法探索。

在星系中心周围，庞大的帝国在争夺权力。其中一个是鸟类文明。在其他人不敢涉足的黑暗之地，这些勇敢的探险家看到了机遇。大迁徙就这样开始了。
texts.en:
We have the first report on the history of Skrand and his people:

In their time the galaxy was vast and unknown, the outer rims considered too dangerous to explore.

Around the galactic center, vast empires vied for power. One was an avian civilization. Where others saw darkness, these intrepid explorers glimpsed opportunity. So began the Great Migration.

texts.zh:
这里附上另一份关于斯克兰德及其人民的历史的报告：

大迁徙在很久以前就结束了。偏安于星系的一隅，斯克兰德的人民们享受着和平而繁荣的日子。但成平日久的他们，没有做好应对威胁的准备。

攻击者不宣而战。没有一双翅膀来得及张开，尖牙立喙也失去了光芒。这些无面入侵者从太空而来，轰炸了鸟类的行星，留下了尸山血海。
texts.en:
Here follows another report on the history of Skrand and his people:

The Migration was long over. Secure along the galaxy's outer rim, Skrand's kin enjoyed both peace and prosperity. But having traded vigilance for comfort, they were unprepared for the coming Menace.

The attackers came without warning. No wings were unfurled; neither talon nor beak flashed in combat. From space the faceless invaders bombed the avian worlds. In their wake they left only death.

texts.zh:
我们收到了下一份关于斯克兰德及其人民的历史的报告：

斯卡拉维德的政府崩溃了，经济也在废墟中陷入停止。但人民的英勇丝毫未减。在远离前线的地方，一个项目正在酝酿之中。

一艘史无前例的舰船将被建造出来。其规模之大足以使敌人胆战心惊。当利爪一号准备就绪时，它被划入了斯卡拉维德最后一位指挥官的指挥之下。年轻又未经考验的斯克兰德·夏普比克上了战场。很快，他的人民就会把他称为威胁克星，斯卡拉维德的第一利爪。
texts.en:
We've received another report on the history of Skrand and his people:

Skravird's government collapsed. Its economy lay in ruins. But the valor of its people was undiminished. Far from the front lines, a project was hatched.

A ship would be built unlike any that had come before. Its sheer scale would strike terror into enemy. When the First Talon was ready, it was placed under the command of the last of Skravird's commanders. Young and untested, Skrand Sharpbeak went to war. Soon his people would hail him as Menace Bane, First Claw of Skravird.

texts.zh:
以下是斯克兰德和他的人民历史的最后一份汇报：

利爪一号，同时也是最后一号，穿过敌人的阵线。船员和指挥官的精明和勇敢带来了一场又一场的胜利。然而，它的航程是短暂的：即使是像利爪号这样的船，也不可能凭一己之力扭转战局。无奈之下，斯克兰德和他的军官们计划在斯克兰德的最后一次防御战中玉石俱焚。在一次包抄敌人的大胆行动中，斯克兰德命令利爪号进入一个未经测试的星门。他和利爪号便从此失去了音信。
texts.en:
Thus reads the final report on the history of Skrand and his people:

The First Talon, first and last of its line, cut through the enemy ranks. Battle after battle was won by the cunning and valor of its crew and their commander. Alas, its flight was short lived: no ship, not even one such as the Talon, could turn the tide of war on its own. In desperation, Skrand and his officers planned to sacrifice themselves in the last defense of Skravird. In a daring bid to outflank the enemy, Skrand ordered the Talon into an untested Gateway. Neither he nor the Talon were ever heard from again.

texts.zh: 在常规调查中，我们发现这艘舰船一直在激活的星门旁警戒，但是对于我们的呼叫没有任何应答，而且其似乎在处于高功率运转状态。
texts.en: During our standard survey, we found a hulking ship standing guard near an activated gate. The vessel is not responding to our summons and appears to be at functioning at critical power levels.

texts.zh: 被称为“坏羽病”的致命疾病影响了斯克兰德的大部分船员。我们的预见到了结果的严峻。目前，我们只能通过提供适当的护理和处理症状来限制疾病的传播。
texts.en: The virulent disease known as Feather Rot has affected most of Skrand's crew. Our forecasts predict a grim outcome. For now, we can only limit the spread of the disease by providing proper care and dealing with the symptoms.

texts.zh: 就像其他任何新疾病，要应对坏羽病，研究总是第一位的。科研团队正在夜以继日地工作寻找治愈方法，我们的医疗人员则在竭力缓解症状，延缓疫情的发展。
texts.en: As with any new disease, lab work is paramount in combating Feather Rot. Research teams are working tirelessly to find a cure, while our medical personnel are fighting to ease symptoms and limit the spread of the disease.

texts.zh: 指挥整合计划关注与缓解海军指挥层的内斗，特别是斯克兰德和我们的人之间的矛盾。寻找到紧张局面的根源可以改善我们指挥流程的效率。
texts.en: The command integration project focuses on easing infighting within the admiralty, especially between Skrand and our own personnel. Addressing the root causes of the tension could improve the efficacy of our command processes.

texts.zh: 联合工程团队发现了一种在利爪号的最核心部分安装额外装甲层的方式。只要有时间和资源，我们就可以切实提升它的防御能力。
texts.en: Joint engineering teams have found a way to install additional layers of armor around the most critical parts of the Talon. Given the time and resources, we will certainly succeed in bolstering its defenses.

texts.zh: 我们被一股强大的力量所袭扰，这些东西试图摧毁我们所熟知的星系中的一切生命。斯克兰德提供了他的专业知识以及利爪号日志中相关的数据，但我们还需要一段时间才能完成全面的分析。
texts.en: We are beset by powerful forces that seek to destroy life in the galaxy as we know it. Skrand has offered his expertise as well as relevant data from the Talon's logs, but it will be some time before we can complete a comprehensive analysis.

texts.zh: 通过对利爪号设计的研究，我们可以从其建造方式中受益，并帮助其团队进行维护。
texts.en: By studying the design of the Talon, we can learn from its construction and better help its team with maintenance.

texts.zh: 利爪号被毁了。但我们已有的知识应该足以将回收来的残骸作为基础，使其能够重新运转。
texts.en: The Talon was destroyed. But given all we have learned, we should be able to use its recovered remains as a base to make it operational once again.

texts.zh: 由于我们对基因科技的精通，斯克兰德的民族可以被复原出来，这能给他们带去希望，并给我们的帝国带来一个全新的开始。
texts.en: Given our expertise in genetics, we should be able to revive Skrand's people, giving them hope and a fresh start in our empire.

texts.zh: 借助利爪的资料库，学习斯克兰德和他的人民的历史可以提供许多独到的见解。
texts.en: Studying the history of Skrand and his people via the Talon's data banks should provide a number of unique insights.

sections.zh: 可持续的自主可以保证项目正常推进的同时又不给我们的经济带来太大的负担。我们的进展将取决于进行该项目的科学家的数量。
sections.en: Sustainable financing will allow the project to move forward without overburdening our economy. Our progress is based on the number of scientists working on this project.

sections.zh: 低资助会显著缩短进展速度，但面对经济危机时可能是一种更保险的策略。我们的进展将取决于进行该项目的科学家的数量。
sections.en: Low funding will slow progress considerably, but can be useful in times of economic crisis. Our progress is based on the number of scientists working on this project.

texts.zh: 我们必须登上这艘外星舰船。微弱的能量读数表明其中可能有一个正常运转的生命维持系统。有可能有人或什么东西潜伏在船上。我们的士兵很想知道答案。
texts.en: We must board the alien vessel. Faint energy readings could indicate a functioning life-support system. There is a chance that someone, or something, may be lurking on the ship. Our soldiers are eager to find out.

texts.zh: 这艘舰船需要进行全面维护。我们自愿支援维修工作。
texts.en: The alien vessel requires extensive maintenance. We have agreed to assist with repairs.
